item.title: Thank you to everyone who ordered a shirt! The preorder window is now closed.
item.description:
Thank you to everyone who ordered a shirt! The preorder window is now closed.

We appreciate your patience and support!

item.title: 📢 1.99 is rolling out now (5/5)
item.description:
📢 1.99 is rolling out now (5/5)

We’re also pleased to include 3 new community translations: Welsh, Scottish Gaelic, and Esperanto.

As always, we’d like to thank our contributors and translators, including new contributors NicolasBorlet and seth-wood!
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: 📢 1.99 is rolling out now (4/5)
item.description:
📢 1.99 is rolling out now (4/5)

Mute accounts more quickly!

Tap the “…” three-dot menu and select "Mute account" to mute directly from a post.
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: 📢 1.99 is rolling out now (3/5)
item.description:
📢 1.99 is rolling out now (3/5)

In addition to tooling to reduce DM spam, we’ve also added a new Chat Requests screen for messages from unknown users. You can accept or reject new conversations here.
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: 📢 1.99 is rolling out now (2/5)
item.description:
📢 1.99 is rolling out now (2/5)

People said it couldn’t be done, but we cracked the technology:

Videos can now be up to 3 minutes long!

Put another way, the Bee Movie now only takes 30 posts. (Please don’t test that.)
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: 📢 App Version 1.99 is rolling out now (1/5)
item.description:
📢 App Version 1.99 is rolling out now (1/5)

With every update, we’re aiming to make the Internet less toxic, more fun, and more in your control.

• 3 minute videos!
• A separate request inbox for DMs from unknown users
• Mute accounts more quickly
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: Every few years, we sign up for yet another platform just to keep in touch with our friends. Private platforms have locked users in for too long, caus...
item.description:
Every few years, we sign up for yet another platform just to keep in touch with our friends. Private platforms have locked users in for too long, causing a lack of innovation & competition in social media.

Bluesky aims to fundamentally change this.

Live in 20 min with @jay.bsky.team:
Bluesky's CEO on the Future of Social Media | SXSW LIVE
YouTube video by SXSW

item.title: 📢 1.98 is rolling out now (4/5)
item.description:
📢 1.98 is rolling out now (4/5)

Find posts by specific users more easily!

You can now go to their profile, tap the “…” three-dot menu, and select “Search posts.”
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: 📢 1.98 is rolling out now (3/5)
item.description:
📢 1.98 is rolling out now (3/5)

To set the default reply settings for all future posts, head to Settings > Moderation > Interaction Settings.

You can also always change reply settings per post.
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: 📢 1.98 is rolling out now (2/5)
item.description:
📢 1.98 is rolling out now (2/5)

Choose who can reply to your posts by clicking into “Anybody can interact.”

Now you can choose “your followers” as an option — aka only people who follow you can reply to the post!
item.author: Bluesky

item.title: 📢 App Version 1.98 is rolling out now, including: (1/5)
item.description:
📢 App Version 1.98 is rolling out now, including: (1/5)

• a new option for who can reply to your posts
• search posts by a user
• lots of little improvements to make the app feel better!
